scopes_hint: the part of the organisation this admin governs

unlock_account_confirm: Unlock this admin account? This clears the failed-login lockout so they can sign in again.
force_password_change_confirm: Require this admin to set a new password at next login? Their current password keeps working until then, and they will be signed out everywhere.
workspace_help: Choose which dashboard tabs and sidebar sections this admin sees. "Default" follows their permissions; Always show / Hide overrides it.
reset_settings_confirm: Reset all settings to defaults? This cannot be undone.

boolean_help: Select whether this feature is enabled or disabled.
secret_help: Enter a new value to change it, or leave blank to keep the current secret.
onboarding_help: People who self-registered (open signup or SSO) are waiting here. Place each into a site / department / service and role, optionally with a supervisor or manager — that creates their account and grants full access. Reject removes the request.
schedules_help_html: Email a saved report template automatically on a recurring schedule. Reports run with your data scope and are delivered as CSV attachments — ideal for compliance packs, weekly readiness reviews and site briefings.
no_templates: No saved report templates yet — build a report and save it as a template first.
no_schedules: No schedules yet — create one above.

lc_no_home_country: No home country configured — every employee with a nationality will count as expatriate. Set "localContentHomeCountry" in Settings.

geo_empty: No countries defined yet. Add one above, then assign it to your sites (edit a site).

lc_view_succession: View succession candidates for this role

setup_email_sub: Enables notifications, scheduled reports and the weekly manager digest.
setup_dismiss: Hide the setup banner from the dashboard
setup_banner_sub: A few steps left and you're ready to go.
role_family_hint: Groups this role in the Benchmark family filter and analytics.
read_only_notice: View-only access — you can browse this page but editing requires additional permissions.
duplicate_role_tooltip: Create a new role as a copy of this one (all skill requirements copied)
duplicate_role_confirm: Duplicate role "{{name}}"? A new role will be created with the same description, family and all skill requirements — you can then adjust the levels.
geo_manage_tip: Manage countries, regions and each site's operating country
copilot_test_help: Tests the connection configured above (provider, URL, model, API key). A reachable model answers copilot questions in free form; otherwise the built-in deterministic engine answers. Data never leaves your server unless you point the URL at a cloud provider.
copilot_trains_on_data: free tier may train on prompts
copilot_trains_on_data_title: This provider's free tier or default terms allow prompts to be used for model training. No preset defaults to a free-tier model.
copilot_guardrails_note: EU AI Act guardrails: every answer is labelled “AI-generated — decision support only; a person makes the decision”. Ranking or naming individual people is off unless copilot.allow_named_person_ranking is on. While copilot.eu_only_providers is on (default), non-EU presets are refused and the built-in engine answers instead.
env_panel_help: Boot-level configuration of the server process itself. These values are set in the .env file on the server and require a service restart to change — they cannot be edited here because the running process reads them at startup (database connection, ports, keys, pools, paths). Everything else above IS editable in-app. Secrets are masked.
brand_help: Turn the platform into your company's own asset: name, logo, tagline and accent colour apply everywhere (sidebar, login page, browser tab, buttons and highlights) immediately — no restart. Branding is stored in the database, so backups and snapshots carry it.
brand_reset_confirm: Reset name, logo, tagline and colours to the default {{brand}} identity?
rb_schedules_title: Recurring email delivery of saved templates
rb_no_sections_hint: Use the Config panel on the left to add chart and table sections to your report.
rb_sql_empty: -- Add sections to see generated SQL
emp_edit_supervisor_hint: Select a supervisor for this employee
emp_edit_manager_hint: A manager can be an employee or an admin account. If none is set, the admin account inherits manager authority.
emp_cred_intro: Set or change this employee's username and/or password. Works whether or not the account already exists. Leave password blank to keep the current one.
emp_cred_password_hint: (min 12 characters; common passwords are refused; blank = unchanged)

emp_js_enter_creds: Enter a username and/or a password.
par_intro: A supervisor can contest an ALREADY APPROVED level and propose a correction. Because the score already carries a manager's approval, only an administrator can decide it — neither the supervisor nor the manager may overturn an approval on their own.
par_admin_only_note: You can open a case, but the decision belongs to an administrator.
mv_intro: Everything that moves, on one page: organisational movements (site, department, service, role, reporting line, status) and assessor activity. Movements are captured by the database itself, so imports, SCIM and SSO are covered just like the UI.
mv_empty: No events for the selected period and scope.
ap_send_creds_title: Generates a username + temporary password and emails it (forced change at first login)
ap_unlock_title: Unlocks an account blocked after failed attempts — immediate sign-in
inv_intro: Select the employees to invite: each receives a welcome email introducing the system, their own profile details, what is expected of them, and their credentials — password change forced at first login. Unused invitations expire after {{days}} day(s) (setting invitationExpiryDays).
inv_smtp_off_body: (Settings → Email: SMTP host + master switch). Accounts will still be created but no email will go out — a one-time credentials sheet will be offered for download after sending.
inv_creds_warn: Available ONLY now — hand each credential over securely.
inv_badge_expired_title: The temporary credential is refused — re-invite
inv_noemail_body: Not invitable until an address exists — fix them right here.
inv_js_confirm: Send {{n}} invitation(s)? Each recipient gets NEW credentials (forced change at first login).
inv_js_confirm_active: The selection includes ALREADY ACTIVE accounts: their current password will be overwritten!
inv_js_refresh: Refresh the page to update the statuses.
inv_csv_headers: Employee Number;Name;Username;Temporary Password;Reason email not sent
qp_intro: The daily operational question: who on this site can do this task at the required level, with a valid certificate, and with no planned absence.
qp_pick_skill: Pick a skill to run the lookup.
qp_found: person(s) at level {{level}} or above for "{{skill}}"
cg_intro: Create the whole grid in one pass: one rule per site (or department) for each selected skill. Preview first — nothing is written until you commit.
cx_intro: A manager or an administrator can request the cancellation of a coaching plan, a mentoring plan, a PIP or an IDP. The request always needs a reason and is never applied on its own: a local admin covering that employee must approve it, and it cannot be the requester.
cx_manager_note: You can request a cancellation; the decision belongs to a local admin.
cx_trace_note: Nothing is deleted: the plan is marked cancelled and the request keeps who asked, why, who decided and the previous state.
cx_sent: Request sent — awaiting a local admin’s approval.
ar_subtitle: Periodic review of every privileged (admin) account — role, scope, permissions, MFA and last activity. Attestations are recorded in the tamper-evident audit log.
lic_subtitle: This appliance is licensed to one customer. Seat = one active employee. Enforcement is soft — you are never locked out of your own data.
lic_unmanaged_hint: No license configured — all features enabled, no seat limit. Paste a license below to formalise entitlement.
lic_json_hint: Fields: customer, seats (number or omit for unlimited), features (["*"] or a list of module slugs), expiresOn (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to return to unmanaged.
lic_enforce_label: Hard-block new employees over the seat cap
lic_enforce_hint: Off by default — normally the appliance only warns. When on, creating an employee beyond the licensed seats is refused.
lic_banner_overseat: You are over your licensed seat count.
onb_merge_title: This SSO sign-in matches an existing account.
onb_merge_body: Merge to link it (no duplicate) instead of creating a new employee below.
access_identity_signs_in_sso: This admin signs in with SSO.
access_identity_not_linked: Not linked. Attach an AD / O365 identity so this admin's SSO sign-in resolves to this account.
access_identity_external_id_label: External id (Entra object id / IdP subject)
access_identity_auth_policy_help: Per-account sign-in requirement. « Default »: password, or SSO when a provider is active (SSO is then mandatory for every administrator but the super administrator). « Password only »: never SSO — honoured only for a super administrator while SSO is enforced. « MFA required »: mandatory two-factor enrolment.
access_identity_revoke_help: Deactivate this promoted admin account and free its SSO identity — sign-in reverts to the underlying employee.
access_identity_revoke_confirm: Revoke admin access? The account is deactivated.

ap_profile_partial: You can only grant {{granted}} of this profile's {{total}} permissions: the rest exceed your own.
ap_profile_applied_note: Profile applied. The advanced checkboxes below were updated; you can still adjust them before saving.
ap_profile_none_note: No profile: tick permissions one by one in the advanced section below.
ap_advanced_hint: These checkboxes are what gets saved. The profile only pre-ticks them.
ap_duration_hint: delegated access is re-certified: permanent access should stay the exception
ap_duration_permanent_hint: no end date — reserve this for governance accounts
ap_expiry_invalid: The access end date is missing, unreadable or already past. Pick a future date, or select “Permanent access”. Nothing was saved.
ap_extend_title: Pushes the end date of this account's permissions AND scopes to 12 months from today
ap_extend_confirm: Extend {{username}}'s access by 12 months? This account's permissions and scopes — including any that already expired — will be valid until that new date.
ap_extend_done: {{username}}'s access now runs until {{date}} ({{perms}} permission(s), {{scopes}} scope(s)).
ap_extend_nothing: This account holds no permission or scope to extend. Give it an access profile first.
ap_extend_not_applicable: A SuperAdmin account holds every permission implicitly: it has no access duration to extend.
acc_page_subtitle: What your account covers and what it can do. This page only ever shows your own access.
acc_admins_only: This page is reserved for administrator accounts.
acc_scope_help: Your actions stay limited to these organisational units, even for the capabilities you do hold.
acc_scope_orgwide_help: As a SuperAdmin, your access is not limited to any country, site, department or service.
acc_scope_none_help: No scope is assigned to you, so you see no employees at all. Ask an administrator to assign you a country, site, department or service.
acc_scope_covers: Active employees covered by this scope:
acc_expiry_none: Your access has no expiry date.
acc_caps_help: The full catalogue of delegable rights. Anything greyed out is not granted to you — ask an administrator for it if your work requires it.
acc_caps_super_help: As a SuperAdmin you implicitly hold the entire catalogue.
acc_caps_request_help: To obtain a capability, contact an administrator who can manage accounts: they add it from your administrator record.
acc_403_subtitle: You are signed in, but your account does not carry the right needed for this action.
acc_403_missing_any_title: Missing capability (any one of these is enough)
acc_403_scope_employee: This employee does not belong to the site, department or service assigned to you. Nothing is missing from your capabilities: it is the scope.

acc_403_scope_department: This department is not part of the scope assigned to you.
acc_403_scope_service: This service is not part of the scope assigned to you.
acc_403_granters_help: Contact one of these people: they administer accounts and can grant you this right.
acc_403_granters_generic: Contact the platform administrator to request this right.

edit_employees.label: Edit employees
edit_employees.desc: Create and edit employees and activate accounts — within the assigned scope. Does NOT include resetting passwords.

reset_employee_password.label: Reset employee passwords / set credentials
reset_employee_password.desc: Reset an employee’s password or set their login credentials — a sensitive action, delegated separately from general editing.

view_employees.label: View employees
view_employees.desc: Browse the employee directory and open an employee record (identity, org placement, role) — within the assigned scope. Read-only, and withholdable: an admin delegated only configuration or reporting work never needs to read staff PII.

manage_employees.label: Manage employees (full)
manage_employees.desc: Full employee administration: create/edit, activate accounts and reset passwords — within the assigned scope.

manage_assessments.label: Manage skill assessments
manage_assessments.desc: Record and adjust employee skill assessments in the matrix — within the assigned scope.

manage_cycles.label: Manage assessment cycles
manage_cycles.desc: View and manage assessment cycles (create, open, lock, close the campaign windows). Admins only.

manage_onboarding.label: Manage onboarding
manage_onboarding.desc: Review self-onboarded users (open signup / SSO) and place them into a site, department, service and role with a supervisor or manager — which creates their account.

manage_organization.label: Manage organization
manage_organization.desc: Create and edit sites, departments and services.

view_domains_skills.label: View domains & skills
view_domains_skills.desc: Browse the competency catalogue (domains and skills). Read-only.

manage_domains_skills.label: Manage domains & skills
manage_domains_skills.desc: Maintain the competency catalogue (domains and skills).

view_roles.label: View roles & requirements
view_roles.desc: View job roles and their required skills/levels. Read-only.

manage_roles.label: Manage roles & requirements
manage_roles.desc: Define job roles and the skills/levels each role requires.

manage_app_settings.label: Manage settings
manage_app_settings.desc: Change global application settings (e.g. the readiness threshold).

export_data.label: Export data
export_data.desc: Download exports and report packs (employees, assessments, organization, templates).

import_data.label: Import / provision data
import_data.desc: Bulk-import and provision data from workbooks. Does NOT include the destructive factory reset.

view_system_logs.label: View system logs
view_system_logs.desc: Read the audit trail and security analytics. Data is scoped to the holder’s clearance: SuperAdmins see all logs; a scope-restricted admin sees only their governed employees’ activity (global infra signals stay SuperAdmin-only).

manage_admins.label: Manage local admins
manage_admins.desc: Create and manage local admins and viewers. Cannot create or edit SuperAdmins, and cannot grant a permission the granter does not hold.

arbitrate_disputes.label: Arbitrate assessment disputes (HR role)
arbitrate_disputes.desc: Act as the final-level (L2) arbiter for assessment disputes that a manager did not resolve in time. This is how an HR business partner is modelled: a scoped local admin holding this grant handles the HR arbitration step inside the system. Decisions are audited and finalise the assessment.

view_continuity.label: View continuity & succession
view_continuity.desc: View succession plans, the bench and coverage of critical roles — within the assigned scope.

manage_succession.label: Manage succession & bench
manage_succession.desc: Designate critical roles, open succession plans, and manage successors / emergency cover.

view_retention_risk.label: View risk-of-loss
view_retention_risk.desc: View and recompute retention / risk-of-loss for employees in scope. Never includes one’s own record.

manage_retention_risk.label: Override risk-of-loss
manage_retention_risk.desc: Override the computed retention / risk-of-loss rating for employees in scope. Never includes one’s own record.

manage_handover.label: Manage knowledge handover
manage_handover.desc: Create and run knowledge-handover plans for leavers and movers.

configure_lms.label: Configure LMS integration
configure_lms.desc: Configure LMS providers (Cornerstone, MyPath, xAPI/LTI), map courses to skills, and manage assignments.

view_compliance.label: View operational compliance
view_compliance.desc: View certification/VOC status, expiring certifications, skill-currency lapses and position-coverage rule status — within the assigned scope.

manage_compliance.label: Manage operational compliance
manage_compliance.desc: Define certification policies, record/revoke employee certifications (VOC), and manage position-coverage rules.

approve_assessments.label: Approve skill assessments
approve_assessments.desc: Approve submitted self-assessments (including bulk approval) and decide post-approval re-reviews — within the assigned scope. The approved rating becomes the employee’s official level.

manage_talent_reviews.label: Manage talent reviews (9-box & calibration)
manage_talent_reviews.desc: Create, approve, disclose and archive 9-box placements, and finalize calibration sessions — confidential talent decisions, within the assigned scope.

manage_mobility.label: Manage internal mobility
manage_mobility.desc: Post internal opportunities, decide applications (accept/decline) and decide cancellation requests — within the assigned scope.

manage_surveys.label: Manage engagement surveys
manage_surveys.desc: Create engagement/eNPS surveys, open and close them, and read aggregated results (individual responses stay anonymous when the survey is anonymous).

manage_invitations.label: Send account invitations
manage_invitations.desc: Open the account/invitations console and send or re-send sign-in invitations — within the assigned scope. Does NOT include resetting an existing password.

maint_assess_hint: Three actions, by state. 'Cancel': a self-assessment raised in error moves to 'rejected', the terminal state every screen excludes. 'Withdraw the review' (under review, changes requested or reviewed by the supervisor): the supervisor's review is withdrawn, the self-assessment returns to 'submitted' exactly as the employee filed it and re-enters the reviewer's queue. 'Request a change' (approved): the approval and the lock are lifted, the self-assessment goes back to the employee. In all three cases the official skill profile is NOT changed until a new approval replaces it.

maint_err_maintenance_review_in_arbitrat: This self-assessment is in arbitration: the manager (or the dispute ladder) decides it.
maint_err_maintenance_review_disputed: A dispute is open on this review: resolve it first.
maint_err_maintenance_review_slot_taken: This employee already has another submitted self-assessment for this skill: deal with that one first (unique constraint on employee + skill + state).

cyc_locked_help: Campaign locked: no more submissions, reviews continue. Reopen it with a new deadline to let latecomers submit, or close it.

adm_lock_not_locked: No lockout in progress (threshold: {{n}} failures in {{minutes}} min).

sso_intro: Let users sign in with their company account. Single sign-on attaches a company identity to an existing IDevelop employee account — by immutable ID (objectId), by a mapping prepared in “SSO migration”, or by verified e-mail; there is no automatic account creation (an unknown person lands in the onboarding queue). Once SSO is switched on, every account signs in with SSO; only the super administrator keeps an emergency password access with two-factor authentication.

set_desc_backupKeep: How many daily backup files to keep (older ones are deleted)
set_desc_backupLastFile: Path of the last successful DB backup
set_desc_backupLastSize: Size in bytes of the last successful DB backup
set_desc_biasZThreshold: Z-score beyond which a 9-box rating pattern raises a bias alert (higher = fewer, stronger alerts)
set_desc_brandAccentColor: Brand accent colour (hex) the interface palette is derived from
set_desc_brandFavicon: Icon shown in the browser tab
set_desc_brandLogo: Logo shown in the sidebar and on the sign-in page
set_desc_brandTagline: Short tagline shown under the application name
set_desc_copilotAnonymizationMode: Cipher/decipher scope: "always" (default — EVERY AI request, internal AND external, carries only anonymized data: personal names + site/department/service/role/org identities replaced with per-request randomized tokens, answers deciphered back) | "external-only" (proven-internal AI servers receive full data). External targets are ALWAYS anonymized regardless of this setting.
set_desc_copilotAnonymizeSkills: Strict mode: also cipher SKILL names in AI requests (hides the capability map, e.g. which certifications the org tracks). Default off — skill names are generic and keeping them makes answers more useful.
set_desc_copilot_allow_named_person_rank: EU AI Act guardrail. Off (default): the copilot never ranks or names individual people (flight-risk lists, “who needs development”, weakest/strongest, open PIPs by name) — it answers with aggregates, and named lists are withheld from any AI model. On: named answers are allowed; every answer still carries the “decision support only” label.
set_desc_copilot_eu_only_providers: Data residency. On (default): only on-prem (ollama) and EU-hosted (mistral) provider presets may be used; a non-EU preset (openai, anthropic, grok, groq, gemini, deepseek, openrouter, together) is refused and the copilot answers with the built-in engine. A custom or overridden endpoint URL is the administrator’s declared choice.
set_desc_companion_enabled: AI companion. On (default): every signed-in user gets the “Assistant” tab in the help panel — how-to answers from the built-in product guide, their own next actions, page and concept explanations; managers and administrators can also ask data questions through the copilot. Works with no language model. When the copilot’s model is configured and allowed, it may rephrase product-guide answers (it never receives personal data). Off: the tab and its API are removed.
set_desc_copilotApiSecret: API key sent to the language-model provider (stored encrypted, never shown again)
set_desc_copilotModel: Model name sent to the endpoint (e.g. llama3.1, gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-5, mistral-large-latest)
set_desc_copilotProvider: LLM connection type: none (deterministic, no LLM) | ollama (Ollama /api/generate) | openai (OpenAI-compatible chat completions — OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LM Studio, vLLM, LocalAI, llama.cpp, Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter…) | anthropic (Claude Messages API) | custom (generic completions: POST {model,prompt})
set_desc_copilotTimeoutMs: Abort an LLM call after this many milliseconds and fall back to the deterministic engine
set_desc_copilotTrustedHosts: Comma-separated hostnames classified as INTERNAL AI servers — e.g. ai.mycompany.com. Localhost, *.local/*.lan/*.internal/*.corp and private-IP targets are internal automatically. Whether internal servers receive full or anonymized data is governed by copilotAnonymizationMode; EXTERNAL targets always receive anonymized data.
set_desc_copilotUrl: Full endpoint URL. Examples — ollama: http://localhost:11434/api/generate · openai-compatible: http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions or https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions · anthropic: https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages · custom: your /v1/completions endpoint
set_desc_cycleAutoCloseGraceDays: Days after the closing date before a locked campaign is closed automatically (finalises rows, generates IDP drafts). -1 = never close automatically; the console stays in charge.
set_desc_cycleAutoLock: Lock an open assessment campaign automatically once its closing date has passed (no new self-assessments; reviews continue).
set_desc_digestDow: Day of week the manager digest is sent (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday; default 1=Monday)
set_desc_digestHour: Hour of day (0-23, server time) after which the weekly manager digest is sent
set_desc_dispute_autoFinalizeOnExpiry: When an L2 dispute exceeds its SLA and no HR arbiter has decided, finalize it automatically with the supervisor rating so the assessment cycle can close.
set_desc_dispute_l0SlaDays: Days an L0 dispute (employee to supervisor) waits before auto-escalating to the manager (L1).
set_desc_dispute_l1SlaDays: Days an L1 dispute (manager) waits before auto-escalating to HR arbitration (L2).
set_desc_dispute_l2SlaDays: Days an L2 dispute (HR arbitration) waits before auto-finalizing with the supervisor rating (if enabled below).
set_desc_edition: Visual edition for charts and branding: 'enterprise' or 'community'
set_desc_emailOnAccess: Email on access-governance events (access review to complete)
set_desc_emailOnAuth: Email on account/security events (new admin account, password changes)
set_desc_emailOnCoaching: Email on coaching plan events (created / completed)
set_desc_emailOnCompliance: Email on compliance events (certification expiry, skills-coverage breach)
set_desc_emailOnDigest: Send the daily personal digest — ONE rollup email replacing per-event mail
set_desc_emailOnDisputes: Email on rating-dispute events (opened / escalated / resolved)
set_desc_emailOnEngagement: Email on engagement events (recognition received) — off by default: kudos never spam
set_desc_emailOnLifecycle: Email on lifecycle events (joiner / mover / leaver, cycle open / close)
set_desc_emailOnMobility: Email on internal-mobility events (opportunity posted, application received)
set_desc_emailOnSurvey: Email on survey events (survey published, response reminder)
set_desc_emailOnTalentActions: Email on talent actions (PIP, IDP, 9-box placement)
set_desc_emailOnValidation: Email on validation events (maker-checker submitted / approved / rejected)
set_desc_emailOnWorkflow: Email on workflow events (self-assessment submitted / approved / rejected / changes requested)
set_desc_featureLocalContent: Enable the local-content module (national-workforce tracking per country)
set_desc_invitationExpiryDays: Days an invitation temporary password stays valid when the person has NEVER signed in. After expiry the login is refused ("invitation expired — contact your administrator") and the Invitations console flags the row for re-invite. 0 = invitations never expire.
set_desc_legalNotice: Legal line shown on the About page (confidentiality notice, or licence attribution)
set_desc_localContentHomeCountry: Home country used as the reference in local-content reports
set_desc_loginLockoutMinutes: Minutes an account stays locked after too many failed sign-ins (also the window in which failures are counted). Env fallback: LOGIN_LOCKOUT_DURATION. Takes effect without restart.
set_desc_maxLoginAttempts: Maximum login attempts before account lockout
set_desc_mfaRequiredForPrivileged: Require two-factor authentication for privileged admin roles (superadmin, regional/country/site admin, HR BP). They are redirected to MFA setup after login until enrolled.
set_desc_notificationRetentionDays: Days to keep READ in-app notifications before pruning
set_desc_onboarding_allowedDomains: Optional comma-separated email domains allowed to self-onboard (e.g. acme.com,acme.org). Blank = any domain.
set_desc_onboarding_allowOpenSignup: Explicitly accept open signup from ANY email domain.
set_desc_onboarding_allowSignup: Show a public "Create account" page where anyone can register (email + password) and land in the onboarding queue.
set_desc_onboarding_allowSso: Auto-create a pending onboarding request when someone signs in via SSO but has no account yet.
set_desc_onboarding_enabled: Master switch — allow people to self-onboard (they wait in a queue until an admin places them into the org).
set_desc_perfEventsRetentionDays: Days to keep performance telemetry (perf_events) before pruning. Audit logs are never pruned.
set_desc_readinessThreshold: Fit percentage from which a person counts as ready for a role
set_desc_nineBoxVisibleToEmployees: Shows each employee their own 9-box placement once it has been disclosed to them. Off: the 9-box appears on no employee page.
set_desc_reminderLogRetentionDays: Days to keep the reminder ledger (reminder_log: one row per nudge sent) before pruning; 0 = keep forever. Audit logs are never pruned.
set_desc_sessionIdleMinutes: Sign users out after this many minutes of inactivity (applies to admins and employees; takes effect immediately)
set_desc_smtpFromAddress: From address for outgoing emails (e.g. no-reply@yourcompany.com)
set_desc_smtpFromName: Display name shown on outgoing emails
set_desc_smtpHost: Hostname of the SMTP server used to send e-mail
set_desc_smtpPassword: SMTP password (stored encrypted, never shown again)
set_desc_smtpPort: SMTP server port (587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit SSL)
set_desc_smtpSecure: Use implicit SSL/TLS (enable for port 465; leave off for 587 STARTTLS)
set_desc_smtpUser: SMTP username for authentication (leave blank for unauthenticated relay)

env_note_TRUSTED_HOSTS: Host headers allowed in email links when APP_BASE_URL is unset
env_note_REDIS_URL: Optional job queue backend (inline when unset)
env_note_APP_KEY: Application encryption key (MFA secrets, SSO overrides…)
env_note_SESSION_MAX_HOURS: Fallback for sessionTimeout (the setting above wins when set)
env_note_LOGIN_RATE: Fallback for maxLoginAttempts (settings above win when set)

cyc_reopen_closed_what: Reopen “%cycle%”, closed on %closedAt% (%days% day(s) ago, window %window% days). Work already approved stays approved. A written reason is mandatory: the reopening is recorded as an override.
cyc_reopen_closed_done: Campaign reopened as an override until %date% — %notified% person(s) notified.
cyc_reopen_window_left: Reopening is possible for another {{days}} day(s) (super-administrator override, {{window}} days after the close).
cyc_reopen_window_last_day: Last day of the {{window}}-day window: reopening as an override is still possible today.
cyc_reopen_window_none: The {{window}}-day reopening window has passed: only a new campaign can measure these people again.
cyc_reopen_window_unknown: This campaign’s closing date was never recorded: the reopening window cannot be checked, so reopening is refused.
cyc_override_line: Reopened as an override on {{date}} — reason: {{reason}}
cyc_err_cycle_write_closed: Campaign {{cycle}} was closed on {{date}}: no further change can be recorded in it.
cyc_err_cycle_write_cancelled: Campaign {{cycle}} was cancelled on {{date}}: no further change can be recorded in it.
cyc_err_cycle_write_draft: Campaign {{cycle}} has not been launched yet: nothing can be written into it.
cyc_err_cycle_write_locked: Campaign {{cycle}} is locked (deadline {{date}}): reviews under way are finished, no new entry is accepted.
cyc_err_cycle_not_closed: Only a closed campaign can be reopened as an override.
cyc_err_reopen_reason_required: A written reason is mandatory to reopen a closed campaign.
cyc_err_cycle_closed_at_unknown: This campaign’s closing date was never recorded: the 30-day window cannot be checked, so reopening is refused. Open a new campaign.
cyc_err_cycle_reopen_window_expired: The campaign was closed on {{date}}, {{days}} day(s) ago: beyond {{window}} days it can no longer be reopened. Open a new campaign.
cyc_proposal_line: This campaign is {{days}} day(s) past its deadline of {{date}}. A closure is PROPOSED (threshold {{threshold}} days): it will never be applied on its own.
cyc_proposal_snapshot: At the time of the proposal: {{notStarted}} never started, {{inProgress}} in progress, {{inReview}} in review, {{approved}} approved out of {{active}} expected.
cyc_proposal_accept_what: Close “%cycle%” now. Only the people who genuinely finished are counted as complete; the rest is written as it stands into the closing record. Reason mandatory.
cyc_proposal_decline_what: Decline the closure proposal for “%cycle%”: the campaign carries on and the proposal stays on file with your reason. Reason mandatory.
cyc_proposal_declined_done: Proposal declined — the campaign carries on.
cyc_never_auto_closed: No campaign is ever closed on its own: the system proposes, a super-administrator decides.
cyc_err_proposal_not_found: There is no closure proposal awaiting a decision on this campaign.
cyc_err_proposal_reason_required: A written reason is mandatory to decide a closure proposal.
cyc_off_campaign_help: A measurement taken outside any campaign is allowed and dated. It is labelled “off campaign” and counts towards NO completion rate.
cyc_role_changed_title: This person has changed role since the campaign was launched.
cyc_role_changed_n: {{n}} person(s) have changed role since the launch
cyc_role_changed_help: They stay counted on the role they held at enrolment: the skill count designed by the department is frozen at launch and is never reduced. Measurements already taken against the former role are kept, dated and attached to this campaign; the person is measured again on their new role in the next campaign.
cyc_err_cycle_write_closed_undated: Campaign {{cycle}} was closed (closing date not recorded): no further change can be recorded in it.
cyc_err_cycle_write_cancelled_undated: Campaign {{cycle}} was cancelled (cancellation date not recorded): no further change can be recorded in it.

set_desc_deptBriefMonthlyEnabled: Send the monthly brief, covering the closed calendar month (in-app, and by e-mail when the digest category is on).
set_desc_deptBriefQuarterlyEnabled: Send the quarterly brief, covering the closed calendar quarter.
set_desc_deptBriefYearlyEnabled: Send the yearly brief, covering the closed calendar year.
set_name_deptBriefYearlySendEmpty: Send the yearly brief even when empty
set_desc_deptBriefYearlySendEmpty: Send the yearly brief even when it has nothing to report. The other cadences stay silent when there is nothing to say; the archive row is written either way and the page shows “nothing to report”.
set_desc_deptBriefHour: Hour (0-23) in UTC — not server time — at or after which a closed period is sent. The brief reads one clock for the gate, the period bucket and the period bounds.
set_desc_deptBriefWeeklyDow: Day of week the weekly brief goes out (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday; default 1=Monday, the day the week closes).
set_desc_deptBriefMonthlyDom: Day of month (1-28) the monthly brief goes out, counted from the first day of the new month.
set_desc_deptBriefQuarterlyDom: Day (1-28) of the first month of the new quarter on which the quarterly brief goes out.
set_desc_deptBriefYearlyDom: Day (1-28) of January on which the yearly brief goes out.
set_desc_deptBriefReviewSlaDays: Number of days after which a self-assessment waiting for review is reported as overdue in the brief.
set_desc_deptBriefMaxLines: Maximum number of action lines in one brief (3 to 12). Past it the brief says “+N other actions” and links to the full page.
set_desc_deptBriefReadRateFloorPct: Read-rate floor for a cadence. After two full periods below it, that cadence is switched off by default rather than reworked: a notification device that cannot be stopped on evidence is irreversible.
set_desc_deptBriefLastRunOn: Date the department-brief job last ran (written by the job, display only). The exactly-once ledger is the briefs table, never this value.
set_desc_deptBriefSince: Date the brief was switched on, written at the first send. A period starting before it is flagged “partial period” and publishes no change figures.
set_desc_deptBriefDataSince: Date of the earliest usable performance action, written at the first send. Same role as “Brief active since”: it stops an empty past being presented as a decline.
health_resend_confirm: Re-send this brief to the named recipient? The archived content is sent as it stands; it is not recomputed.
ssom_subtitle: Map every existing employee onto their SSO identity before the cut-over: at their first SSO sign-in they land on THEIR account — no duplicate, no onboarding request.
ssom_step_1: Configure the provider in SSO settings and test it. For Microsoft Entra (SAML), emit the objectidentifier (default), tenantid and UPN claims, and add employeeid = user.employeeid.
ssom_step_2: Export the directory: Entra → Users → Download users (columns objectId, userPrincipalName, mail, employeeId…), or start from the template.
ssom_step_3: Run the dry run: every row gets an outcome and its reason. Nothing is written.
ssom_step_4: Resolve the rows that need a decision (no match, ambiguous, conflicting keys) by picking the employee, then re-run the dry run.
ssom_step_5: Apply: mappings are recorded. Each activates at the person’s first signed sign-in. Have a few pilot users sign in first.
ssom_tenant_set: Only sign-ins from Entra tenant {{tenant}} can activate a mapping.
ssom_tenant_unset: No expected tenant is configured (AZURE_TENANT_ID or SSO_EXPECTED_TENANT_ID): the tenant id is not checked.
ssom_import_help: CSV file (comma or semicolon, UTF-8), at most {{max}} rows. At least one objectId, userPrincipalName or employeeId column is required.
ssom_provider_off_help: This provider is not active yet: you can prepare the mappings, they are activated at first sign-in once the provider is configured.
ssom_r_will_map: A mapping will be recorded; it activates at the person’s first SSO sign-in.
ssom_r_already_linked: This employee already has an SSO identity for this provider: nothing to do.
ssom_r_already_mapped: An open mapping already exists for this employee. Undo its batch to replace it.
ssom_r_no_match: Neither the employee number, the e-mail nor the UPN matches an employee. Pick them by hand or fix the directory.
ssom_r_ambiguous: This row points at several employees (shared address or duplicated number). Pick the one who signs in with this identity.
ssom_r_conflicting_keys: The employee number points at one employee, the e-mail or UPN at another. Nothing is guessed: pick the right one.
ssom_r_duplicate_in_file: The same objectId, UPN or employeeId appears on several rows: none is kept. Fix the file.
ssom_r_duplicate_target: Several rows land on the same employee: none is kept. Keep a single row.
ssom_r_identity_taken: This objectId is already linked to another account. Remove it there first.
ssom_r_key_taken: One of these keys is already mapped to another employee (open mapping).
ssom_r_inactive: This employee’s sign-in account is inactive: they could not sign in.
ssom_r_local_only: This account is restricted to password sign-in. Change its authentication policy first.
ssom_r_guest: Guest (B2B) accounts are never mapped onto an employee.
ssom_r_directory_disabled: The account is disabled in the directory (accountEnabled = false).
ssom_r_no_claim_key: Without an objectId, UPN or employeeId no sign-in could activate this mapping (e-mail alone proves nothing).
ssom_rerun: Re-run the dry run with my choices
ssom_apply_help: {{n}} mapping(s) out of {{total}} row(s). The other rows are not written and stay listed above with their reason.
ssom_apply_nothing: No row can be mapped as it stands.
ssom_apply_confirm_label: To confirm, type the number of mappings
ssom_confirm_apply: Record {{n}} SSO mapping(s)? Each is claimed at the person’s first sign-in; the batch can be undone.
ssom_undo_prompt: Undo batch #{{id}}? Its {{n}} mapping(s) still awaiting a sign-in are removed; those already activated stay (remove them per account). Reason required:
ssom_undone: Batch undone: {{n}} mapping(s) removed, {{kept}} already activated kept.
ssom_err_generic: The operation failed. Please try again.
ssom_err_empty: The file is empty or only has a header.
ssom_err_no_key_column: No objectId, userPrincipalName or employeeId column found in the header.
ssom_err_too_many: Too many rows: at most {{max}} per file.
ssom_err_no_preview: Dry run not found: run it again.
ssom_err_preview_expired: This dry run is over {{hours}} h old: run it again before applying.
ssom_err_preview_used: This dry run has already been applied.
ssom_err_stale: Nothing was written: you confirmed {{expected}} mapping(s), but the data changed and now yields {{now}}. Run the dry run again.
ssom_apply_stale: Your choices are not applied yet: re-run the dry run before applying.
ssof_connect_intro: Like any enterprise app: copy the values below into Microsoft Entra ID, Okta or ADFS, import your provider’s metadata, then test. Username and password sign-in stays available.
ssof_step_paste: Values to paste into your provider
ssof_step_paste_help: In Entra ID: Enterprise applications → New application → Create your own application (non-gallery) → Single sign-on → SAML. Paste the values below, then under “Users and groups” assign the people (and yourself, for the test). Entra: to import our metadata, download the URL below and use “Upload metadata file”. ADFS: give the URL.
ssof_base_warn: The app’s public address is not https: Entra will reject these URLs. Set “appBaseUrl” (Settings → E-mail) to the https address your users open.
ssof_callback_mismatch: The configured SAML reply URL ({{configured}}) is not the standard address ({{expected}}). It is accepted for now, but register {{expected}} here and as the reply URL in your identity provider, then check that the base address (Settings → E-mail) is the site root, without “/login”.
ssof_step_import_help: Paste the App Federation Metadata URL (Entra: “SAML Certificates” section) or the XML file. The sign-in URL, issuer and every signing certificate are filled in automatically.
ssof_md_or_xml: … or paste the metadata XML file
ssof_md_removed: Certificates that will no longer be trusted
ssof_md_confirm: I have checked the new certificate’s fingerprint with our provider and I trust it.
ssof_md_applied: Metadata applied: the SAML connection has been reloaded.
ssof_md_err: The metadata could not be read.
ssof_md_empty: Give a metadata URL or paste the XML.
ssof_md_too_big: The metadata document is larger than 1 MB.
ssof_md_dtd: Document refused: metadata must not contain a DTD or entities.
ssof_md_unreadable: This is not readable metadata XML.
ssof_md_no_idp: This metadata describes no SAML identity provider.
ssof_md_incomplete: Incomplete metadata: issuer or sign-in URL missing.
ssof_md_no_cert: No signing certificate in this metadata.
ssof_md_bad_cert: A certificate in the metadata is unreadable.
ssof_md_dns: The host name of this URL cannot be resolved from the server.
ssof_md_private: This URL points to an internal network address: refused for security. Paste the XML instead (or set SSO_METADATA_ALLOW_PRIVATE=1 on the server for an internal ADFS).
ssof_md_redirect: The metadata server answered with a redirect: give the final URL.
ssof_md_http: The metadata server answered with HTTP error {{status}}.
ssof_md_timeout: The metadata server did not answer in time (10 s).
ssof_md_unreachable: The metadata server cannot be reached from the app.
ssof_md_confirm_certs: A new signing certificate replaces the trusted ones: tick the confirmation after checking its fingerprint.
ssof_no_cert: No provider certificate is configured yet.
ssof_step_test_help: A real round trip to your provider that opens no session and links no account: you see the claims received and the account that would be opened. To test an employee, choose “Use another account” on the Microsoft page.
ssof_test_needs_active: Import the metadata (step 2) and save: the test works before SSO is switched on.
ssof_next_migration: Next step: map your employees to their company account —
ssof_test_nothing_written: Test only: no session opened, no account linked, no request created.
ssof_test_pending: The provider’s response has not arrived yet.
ssof_test_expired: This test sign-in has expired. Start it again.
ssof_test_unavailable: A test sign-in needs a saved SAML connection (metadata imported).
ssof_hint_oid: No objectId received: Entra always sends it. With another provider (ADFS, Okta), release the immutable ID under this name, or links will rest on the NameID (which changes on a rename).
ssof_r_admin: this is an administrator account and no SSO provider is active: it signs in with password + MFA.
ssof_r_local_only: this account is restricted to password sign-in.
ssof_r_not_provisioned: no account matches: the person would land in the onboarding queue. Map them in “SSO migration”.
ssof_r_email_ambiguous: the e-mail received belongs to several accounts: map the right one in “SSO migration”.
ssof_via_mapping: prepared mapping (SSO migration) — it would be activated
ssof_via_email: verified e-mail (link created at first sign-in)
sso_f_idpInitiated: Allow sign-in launched from the provider portal (My Apps / Okta dashboard)
ssof_md_applied_inactive: Metadata applied. The SAML connection is not active yet: tick “Enable single sign-on” below and save.
ssof_fail_sso_issuer: the response comes from another provider (issuer) than the one configured. Re-import the right provider’s metadata.
ssof_fail_sso_destination: the response was addressed to another application (Destination). Check the Reply URL (ACS) pasted into the provider.
ssof_fail_sso_replay: this response was already used: run the test again.
ssof_fail_sso_saml_invalid: the response was rejected (signature, certificate, audience or validity). Check the imported metadata belongs to this application and the Identifier (Entity ID) is identical on both sides.
ssof_secret_undecryptable: Stored value is unreadable (APP_KEY changed): this provider is disabled. Enter it again.
sso_enforce_help: As soon as SSO is switched on, every account signs in with SSO: the password form disappears from the sign-in page, and only the super administrator keeps a password emergency access (discreet « Emergency access » link), always with two-factor authentication — a super administrator never signs in through SSO. Only the employees a super administrator listed as an “SSO exception” also keep their password. If SSO is on but no provider works, it stays enforced. Administrators sign in with SSO plus two-factor authentication (local, asserted by the identity provider, or a one-time enrolment code). To lift this, switch SSO off.
sso_ready_unavailable: The readiness report could not be computed.
sso_ready_ok: Every active account has an SSO path.
sso_ready_warn_enforced: Some accounts have no way to sign in: SSO is enforced and they hold no SSO identity. Fix the gaps below.
sso_ready_warn_before: Once an SSO provider is activated, the accounts below will no longer be able to sign in. Prepare them first.
sso_ready_admins_help: No SSO identity linked to the administration account, and no linked employee with an SSO identity or a migration mapping. Link an identity from the administrator page, or link them to an employee.
sso_ready_localonly_help: This policy can no longer be honoured while SSO is enforced (they would be locked out): it is treated as « default ». Change it on their page.
sso_ready_employees: {{n}} active employee(s) with no SSO identity and no migration mapping.
sso_ready_admin_list_banner: {{n}} administration account(s) have no usable SSO path.
ssof_r_superadmin_forbidden: this account is a super administrator: it never signs in with SSO (password and two-factor authentication only).
ssof_r_admin_ineligible: this administrator account cannot sign in with SSO right now (inactive, locked, access expired or password-only).
adm_mfa_enrol_code_hint: Issues a one-time code (24 h): the administrator signs in once through SSO with it, then must set up two-factor authentication.
adm_mfa_enrol_code_once: Shown once. Give it to the administrator through a safe channel; it expires in 24 h.
sso_ready_unconfirmed_title: Administrators whose SSO identity is not confirmed: {{n}}
sso_ready_unconfirmed_help: Only an identity linked by a super administrator (or an onboarding merge) opens an administrator account. Check each identity below before confirming it.
sso_confirm_identity_btn: Confirm this identity for administrator access
sso_ready_nomfa_help: Through SSO they only get in if the identity provider asserts two-factor authentication, or with a one-time enrolment code (administrator page).
sso_ready_super_nomfa_help: A super administrator never signs in through SSO: their only door is the password emergency access, where two-factor authentication is mandatory. At their next sign-in they will be held on two-factor (TOTP) enrolment before any other page.
sso_ready_super_shortfall_title: Fewer than two super administrators with two-factor authentication (currently: {{n}})
sso_ready_super_shortfall_help: With a single protected super administrator, a lost authenticator has nobody to reset it: the server recovery tool would be needed (Manage-IDevelop.ps1 -ResetSuperadminMfa). Appoint a second super administrator and have them enable two-factor authentication.
sso_ready_demoted_title: Former super administrators with an SSO path again: {{n}}
sso_ready_demoted_help: These accounts were demoted from super administrator and then regained a trusted SSO identity. Check that this is intended.
sso_ready_super_idents_title: SSO identities ignored on super administrator accounts: {{n}}
sso_ready_super_idents_help: These identities cannot be used to sign in (a super administrator never uses SSO). They are not deleted automatically: you can unlink them from the account page.
sso_help_contact_help: Name, e-mail or phone (one line). Shown under the SSO button on the sign-in page and in the invitation sent to every account migrated to SSO. Empty: “your administrator”.
sso_mfa_acr_help: Comma-separated URIs (urn:…, https://…) or explicit names, in addition to the values recognised out of the box (Entra multipleauthn, SAML MultiFactor). A bare number (« 1 »…) is refused. A single factor (SMS, OTP…) never counts as two-factor authentication.
sso_mfa_acr_invalid: acr values refused: {{values}}. Nothing was saved. Use URIs (urn:…, https://…) or explicit names — never a bare number such as « 1 », which Microsoft Entra sends on every sign-in.
sso_enable_confirm: Switch mandatory SSO on? {{n}} account(s) have no SSO access and will no longer be able to sign in.
sso_enable_confirm_check: I confirm: {{n}} account(s) with no SSO access will no longer be able to sign in (SSO exceptions not counted).
sso_golive_help: Every migrated account (except SSO exceptions and super administrators) receives, once, a short message “From …, you will sign in with your … account”, 48 hours before this date — or at once if the date is closer. The detailed invitation still goes when SSO is switched on.
sso_ann_none: No planned date: no announcement will go out.
sso_ready_exc_help: Employees listed by a super administrator: they keep password sign-in (and reset) while SSO is enforced, and receive no SSO invitation or announcement. Never an administrator account. Manage them from the employee record.
sso_exc_help: Granted by a super administrator to an employee who cannot use SSO: they keep username and password sign-in (and reset) while SSO is enforced. They receive no SSO invitation or announcement. Every change is logged.
sso_exc_none: No exception: this employee signs in with SSO as soon as SSO is enforced.
sso_exc_remove_confirm: Remove the exception? This employee will have to sign in with SSO.
ssof_test_before_activation: The test signs nobody in and works even while the master switch is off: test before you switch on.
ssom_onb_merge_default: SSO migration in progress: attaching this request to the existing account is the recommended action.
ssom_onb_create_anyway_check: I confirm: create a new account despite the matching existing account

about_frameworks_lead: How the controls above map to the main security and privacy standards. This is a self-assessment by the development team, not a certification or an audit opinion.
about_fw_asvs_detail: {{total}} requirements verified in the code: {{pass}} pass, {{fixed}} fixed during the assessment, {{partial}} partial, {{gap}} open gaps, {{na}} not applicable, {{nv}} not verifiable from the code.
about_fw_top10_detail: Each of the ten risk categories is mapped to the controls and tests that address it.
about_fw_cwe_detail: The most dangerous software weaknesses, each mapped to a control, or marked as not applicable.
about_fw_iso_detail: The technological controls the application implements (A.5.15, A.5.34, A.8.2–A.8.28…) are mapped; the organisational controls stay with the deploying organisation.
about_fw_soc2_detail: Logical access, system operations and change management criteria supported by product controls.
about_fw_gdpr_detail: Supports Articles 5, 15–17, 25, 30, 32 and 35: access, export, erasure, retention, register, privacy by default, security of processing.
about_fw_aiact_detail: Transparency (Article 13) and human oversight (Article 14) for the copilot and the built-in assistant.
about_fw_ssdf_detail: Secure development practices: reviewed changes, automated tests on every change, dependency audit, vulnerability disclosure.
about_fw_foot: Details: docs/ASVS-L2.md and docs/COMPLIANCE-MAPPING.md, including what the deploying organisation must still do (policies, penetration test, DPIA, hosting, off-site backups).
mod_intro: Start small and switch more on when your organisation is ready. Switching a module off hides its menus and pages; nothing is deleted and its data is kept. Changes apply on the next page, without a restart.
mod_legacy_notice: The server is started with V2_FEATURES=1: every module stays on whatever you choose here. Your choice is saved and applies once that variable is removed from the server configuration.
mod_stage1_gets: Your skills framework and roles, self-assessments, manager reviews and disputes, readiness, skill gaps, reports and assessment campaigns.
mod_stage1_who: HR sets up the framework and runs the campaigns; every employee assesses themselves; managers review.
mod_stage2_gets: Everything in stage 1, plus development plans, coaching and improvement plans, calibration, succession and continuity, and internal mobility.
mod_stage2_who: Managers and HR business partners join talent reviews and development conversations.
mod_stage3_gets: Everything in stage 2, plus surveys, recognition, OKRs and 1:1 check-ins, and the AI copilot.
mod_stage3_who: The whole organisation, day to day. The AI copilot keeps its own guardrails (EU-hosted providers only, no ranking of named people), set under Settings → Talent copilot (AI).
mod_custom_gets: Choose each module yourself, for an organisation whose needs do not match a stage.
mod_name_development: Development (development plans, coaching, improvement plans, learning)
mod_name_mobility: Mobility (internal opportunities, joiner / mover / leaver events)
mod_localcontent_hint: A regional option, independent of the stage.
mod_impact_legacy: V2_FEATURES=1 keeps every module on for now.
mod_core_note: Always on, whatever the stage: the skills framework, roles, self-assessments, reviews and disputes, readiness, gaps, the 9-box grid, each person’s own development plan, reports and access management.
mod_confirm: Save this choice? Menus change for everyone on their next page.
mod_saved: Modules saved. Menus change on the next page.
setup_modules_sub: Pick an adoption stage: start with the framework and assessments, add talent, development and engagement modules later.
hris_intro: Feed employees from your HRIS: joiners, movers and leavers are prepared in a dry run, reviewed, then applied with the same rules as the employee form.
hris_state_enabled: Active connector: {{provider}}. The sync runs every night.
hris_state_auto: Changes are applied automatically unless the safety threshold is exceeded.
hris_state_review: Every night a plan is prepared and the super-administrators are notified: nothing is applied without review.
hris_state_disabled: No connector is active: the scheduled sync does nothing. Configure a connector, test it, run a dry run, then enable it.
hris_provider_csv_sub: Your HRIS drops an export into a server folder (for example through your own SFTP), or you upload it here. The newest file in the folder is read.
hris_provider_personio_sub: Personio API v1: client credentials (client ID and secret) created in Personio, read-only access to /company/employees.
hris_provider_lucca_sub: Lucca API v3: an API key for your tenant, read-only access to users, their departments and legal entities.
hris_not_validated: Connector implemented from the public API documentation, not yet validated against a live tenant: start with a dry run.
hris_guard_hint: Safety: if a run would deactivate more than this share of active employees (10% by default), or if a full export is empty, nothing is applied and the super-administrators are alerted.
hris_mode_full: Full: a person who is absent has left
hris_folder_hint: Path read by the scheduled job. When HRIS_DROP_ROOT is set, the folder must sit inside it.
hris_columns_hint: Leave blank to use the default header shown in grey. Case, accents and separators are ignored.
hris_base_url_personio_hint: Leave blank for https://api.personio.de. Only public https addresses are accepted.
hris_base_url_lucca_hint: Your tenant address, for example https://acme.ilucca.net. Only public https addresses are accepted.
hris_attributes_hint: The Personio attribute name for each field (the employee number is often a custom attribute, for example dynamic_123456). The attribute must be allowed for your API credentials.
hris_credentials_hint: Encrypted at rest and never shown again. Leave a box blank to keep the stored value. A recent sign-in or your current password is needed to change them.
hris_dry_run_done: Dry run finished: review the plan before applying it.
hris_upload_hint: The file is read once to prepare a dry run; nothing is applied before you confirm.
hris_plan_empty_text: Run a dry run or upload an export to see the proposed joiners, movers and leavers.
hris_run_failed: The export could not be read:
hris_guard_tripped_title: Safety threshold exceeded: this plan cannot be applied.
hris_guard_numbers: {{leavers}} leaver(s) out of {{population}} active employees, that is {{pct}}% (threshold: {{limit}}%).
hris_guard_tripped_flash: Safety threshold exceeded: nothing was applied. Check the export.
hris_apply_hint: The plan is recomputed when applied and the safety threshold checked again.
hris_apply_confirm: Apply {{joiners}} joiner(s), {{movers}} mover(s) and {{leavers}} leaver(s)? Leavers have their accounts switched off.
hris_applied_with_errors: Plan applied with {{n}} error(s): see the detail below.
hris_unmapped_hint: These HRIS values match no local unit or role. Nothing is guessed: map them, then run a new dry run.
hris_manager_unmapped_hint: Unknown manager: linked as soon as they are synchronised.
hris_upcoming: {{n}} future joiner(s): created on their start date.
hris_r_site_mismatch: The site does not contain this department
hris_r_email_ambiguous: Several accounts carry this e-mail: match by hand
hris_r_inactive_here: Active in the HRIS but deactivated here: to check
hris_r_placement_inconsistent: Site, department and service do not nest
hris_r_too_many_leavers: Too many leavers in one run
hris_mappings_hint: An HRIS value (a department, site or service name, a job title) points to a local unit or role. These rules serve every connector and SCIM provisioning.
hris_mappings_empty_text: Without mappings, only values identical to the local names are recognised.
hris_scim_hint: When an identity provider creates a user through SCIM, their department, manager, employee number and title (enterprise extension) go through the same mappings. When everything maps, the person is placed directly; otherwise the request waits in the onboarding queue.
hris_history_empty_text: Every dry run and every apply is listed here with its figures.
hris_err_url_scheme: Only public https addresses are accepted.
hris_err_url_credentials: The address must not carry credentials.
hris_err_url_private: Address refused: it targets an internal, loopback or metadata network.
hris_err_url_unresolved: The server name does not resolve.
hris_err_timeout: The HRIS did not answer in time.
hris_err_redirect: The HRIS answered with a redirect, which is never followed.
hris_err_csv_outside_root: The drop folder is outside HRIS_DROP_ROOT.
hris_err_csv_unreadable: The drop folder cannot be read.
hris_err_csv_no_file: The drop folder holds no .csv or .tsv file.
hris_err_not_configured: This connector is not configured yet.
hris_err_run_not_applicable: Only a dry run awaiting review can be applied.
hris_err_run_too_old: This dry run is too old: run a new one.
hris_err_mapping_target: Choose an active unit or role of the right kind.
hris_err_upload: File refused: a .csv, .tsv or .txt file of 25 MB at most.
setup_hris_sub: Optional: sync joiners, movers and leavers from a dropped CSV export, Personio or Lucca.
integrations_hris_text: HRIS synchronisation: a CSV export dropped on the server, Personio or Lucca, with a dry run, value mappings and a safety threshold.
set_name_hris_scimAutoPlace: SCIM: direct placement through the HRIS mappings
set_desc_hris_scimAutoPlace: A new SCIM user is placed directly (site, department, service, role, supervisor) when every value of the enterprise extension maps; otherwise the request waits in the onboarding queue.
